restrictions: Run coins S0,S1 (256-bit) and table tag T drawn once; group prefix P_g = Trunc_52(H(S0||BE104(g)||S1)) with one charged target compression per group (proof.md §2, §9).
Messages m(g,u)=P_g||BE24(u), 55 bytes, one block; N=2^128 samples in global cid order.
Eight-message SWAR batches share P_g; rounds 0..12 once; single W_0..W_12 parse; measured batch word ops 2723 plus 8 sequential 9-op table probes (72 ops) locked in trial 0.

Table key uses digest 144-bit prefix XOR run tag T; sparse-set Lemma 2. On hit, rebuild both messages from (S0,S1,cid) via Lemma 1; two scalar H verifications; at most 2^113 + 2^40 + 1 cold verifications.
Score-critical H1-table-rf (table tails only) and H2-eight-lane-swar. Generic search.

heuristics.statement: Over fresh (S0,S1,T) and the keyed sparse-set probes, the probability of table failure from (F2) overwrite before verifying a colliding key, (F3) more than 2^113 false 144-bit key matches, or (F4) more than 2^40 equal-key unequal-digest verifications, exceeds the uniform-model tail by at most 0.004 (so combined with §5 birthday success remains > 0.39).
heuristics.scope: Deterministic prefixes from (S0,S1,g), tagged keys κ(H), 140-bit sparse addresses, global cid order with sequential probes inside each batch.
heuristics.extrapolation: From cigts-mask-spread (32 messages, 16-bit mask) and cigts-mask-single-group (512 consecutive u) to N=2^128 and 144-bit keys.
heuristics.limitations: Mask experiments do not observe full collisions or 144-bit saturation.

heuristics.statement: For any 52-byte prefix P_g and eight 24-bit values u, the SWAR batch in proof.md §6–7 equals eight serial target compressions of P_g||u.
heuristics.scope: Single-block 55-byte messages; eight 32-bit lanes; shared W_0..W_12.
heuristics.extrapolation: Trial 0 checks eight diverse u and batch_ops=2723.
heuristics.limitations: Not exhaustive over all u; mis-implementation refutes.
